tools.name: tradingview_scan
tools.description: Scan US stocks with custom filters (price > X, RSI < 30, etc.). Returns up to `limit` rows with the requested columns.

exchange.description: Exchange filter, e.g. NASDAQ, NYSE, AMEX

tools.name: tradingview_compare_stocks
tools.description: Returns price, change, market cap, P/E, EPS, revenue, dividend yield, RSI, and analyst recommendation rating (-1 sell to +1 buy) for 2-5 stocks. Revenue growth rate and analyst price targets are not available.

tickers.description: 2-5 stock tickers to compare (e.g. AAPL, MSFT)

tools.name: tradingview_quote
tools.description: Get a 15-minute delayed quote for one or more stock tickers (e.g. 'AAPL' or 'NASDAQ:AAPL'). Returns price, change, volume, market cap, and pre-market/after-hours data when available. Data is delayed ~15 minutes during market hours — use finnhub_quote for real-time prices if available. If a ticker returns empty results, retry with the correct exchange prefix (e.g. 'NYSE:CDE', 'AMEX:XYZ').

tools.name: tradingview_technicals
tools.description: Get technical indicators (RSI, MACD, moving averages, pivot points, etc.) for one or more stock tickers. If a ticker returns empty results, retry with the correct exchange prefix (e.g. 'NYSE:CDE', 'AMEX:XYZ').

tools.name: tradingview_top_gainers
tools.description: Get today's top gaining stocks by percentage change on a given exchange. Defaults to major US exchanges (NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX) with market cap > $100M. OTC penny stocks excluded by default.

include_otc.description: Whether to include OTC penny stocks (default: false)

tools.name: tradingview_top_losers
tools.description: Get today's top losing stocks by percentage change on a given exchange. Defaults to major US exchanges (NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX) with market cap > $100M. OTC penny stocks excluded by default.

include_otc.description: Whether to include OTC penny stocks (default: false)

tools.name: tradingview_top_volume
tools.description: Get stocks with the highest trading volume today. Defaults to major US exchanges.

include_otc.description: Whether to include OTC penny stocks (default: false)

tools.name: tradingview_market_indices
tools.description: Get real-time values for major market indices: VIX (volatility), S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, and Dow Jones. Essential for gauging broad market conditions, risk sentiment, and options pricing context.

tools.name: tradingview_sector_performance
tools.description: Get performance of S&P 500 sector ETFs (XLK, XLF, XLE, XLV, XLI, XLP, XLU, XLY, XLC, XLRE, XLB). Shows which sectors are leading or lagging today. Essential for sector rotation analysis.

tools.name: tradingview_volume_breakout
tools.description: Find stocks with unusual volume (current volume significantly above average). Defaults to major exchanges.

tools.name: crypto_scan
tools.description: Scan cryptocurrency pairs using TradingView filters. Returns price, volume, and technical indicators.

tools.name: crypto_quote
tools.description: Get real-time quotes for specific crypto pairs. Supports 'BTCUSDT' (defaults to BINANCE) or 'BINANCE:BTCUSDT'.

tools.name: crypto_technicals
tools.description: Get technical analysis for crypto pairs. Supports 'BTCUSDT' or 'BINANCE:BTCUSDT'.

tools.name: crypto_top_gainers
tools.description: Get top gaining cryptocurrency pairs by percentage change. Defaults to major exchanges and volume > $10k.

tools.name: edgar_search
tools.description: Search SEC EDGAR filings by keyword. Best for finding mentions of specific trends, technologies, or events across all companies. Returns metadata including accession numbers, form types, and direct sec.gov links.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for (e.g. 'lithium mining', 'share repurchase program')

tools.name: edgar_company_filings
tools.description: Retrieve the most recent official filings for a specific company. Use this to find a company's latest 10-K (annual), 10-Q (quarterly), or 8-K (current events) reports.

tools.name: edgar_company_facts
tools.description: Retrieve high-fidelity financial metrics (Revenue, Net Income, EPS, Assets, Liabilities) directly from SEC XBRL data. This is more reliable than extracting numbers from text filings.

tools.name: edgar_insider_trades
tools.description: Monitor legal stock trades made by company executives and directors (Forms 3, 4, 5). Returns detailed transaction data including insider names, titles, buy/sell type, share amounts, and prices.

tools.name: edgar_institutional_holdings
tools.description: Track 'big money' moves by searching Form 13F filings. Use to find what hedge funds and institutional managers (e.g. 'Berkshire Hathaway') are holding or what firms own a specific ticker.

query.description: Stock ticker (e.g. 'AAPL') or institutional manager name (e.g. 'Berkshire Hathaway')

tools.name: edgar_ownership_filings
tools.description: Monitor significant changes in company ownership (5%+ stakes). Use 13D and 13G filings to identify activist investors (e.g. Carl Icahn, Ryan Cohen) entering or exiting a stock.

tools.name: coingecko_coin
tools.description: Get detailed cryptocurrency info from CoinGecko. Use slug IDs (e.g. 'bitcoin', 'ethereum', 'solana'), NOT ticker symbols.

tools.name: coingecko_trending
tools.description: Get trending cryptocurrencies on CoinGecko (top 7 by search popularity in last 24h).

tools.name: coingecko_global
tools.description: Get global cryptocurrency market statistics: total market cap, 24h volume, BTC/ETH dominance.

tools.name: options_expirations
tools.description: Get all available option expiration dates for a stock ticker. Call this first to discover valid dates, then pass one to options_chain or options_max_pain.

tools.name: options_chain
tools.description: Get the full option chain (calls and puts) with calculated Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega). Use options_expirations first to find valid dates. If expiration is omitted, uses nearest date. By default, returns strikes within ±20% of current price to save tokens. Use strike_min/strike_max for custom range, or all_strikes=true for everything.

expiration.description: Expiration date as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. '2026-04-17'). If omitted, uses nearest.

all_strikes.description: Return all strikes instead of centering around ATM (default: false)

tools.name: options_unusual_activity
tools.description: Find options contracts with unusually high volume relative to open interest (a common 'smart money' signal). Scans the nearest expiration and flags contracts where volume/OI exceeds a threshold.

volume_oi_ratio.description: Min volume/OI ratio to flag as unusual (default: 3.0)

tools.name: options_max_pain
tools.description: Calculate the max pain strike price — where cumulative option open interest expires worthless. This level often acts as a support/resistance zone near expiration.

expiration.description: Expiration date as YYYY-MM-DD. If omitted, uses nearest.

tools.name: options_implied_move
tools.description: Calculate the expected move implied by options pricing (ATM straddle). Essential for earnings plays — shows how much the market expects the stock to move. Compare implied vs historical moves to assess if premium is cheap or expensive.

expiration.description: Expiration date as YYYY-MM-DD. If omitted, uses nearest.

tools.name: options_put_call_ratio
tools.description: Get historical put/call ratio from CBOE (market-wide sentiment indicator). Ratio > 1.0 = more puts (bearish sentiment), < 0.7 = more calls (bullish/complacent). Types: 'total' (all options), 'equity' (stock options only), 'index' (index options only).

days.description: Number of recent trading days to return (default: 30, max: 252)

tools.name: sentiment_fear_greed
tools.description: Get the CNN Fear & Greed Index for the US stock market. Returns a composite score (0-100) with rating (extreme fear/fear/neutral/greed/extreme greed) and 7 sub-indicators: S&P 500 momentum, stock price strength (52w highs vs lows), stock price breadth (McClellan), put/call ratio, VIX, junk bond demand, safe haven demand. Also includes previous close, 1-week, 1-month, and 1-year scores for trend context. Use this to gauge overall market sentiment before analyzing individual stocks.

tools.name: sentiment_crypto_fear_greed
tools.description: Get the Crypto Fear & Greed Index from Alternative.me. Returns a score (0-100) with rating (extreme fear/fear/neutral/greed/extreme greed). Based on Bitcoin volatility, market volume, social media, surveys, dominance, and trends. Use this alongside coingecko tools for crypto market context.

tools.name: frankfurter_latest
tools.description: Get latest forex exchange rates from the European Central Bank. Returns daily reference rates for 31 major currencies. Updated once per business day at ~16:00 CET. These are reference rates, not real-time trading rates.

symbols.description: Comma-separated target currencies (e.g. 'EUR,GBP,JPY'). Omit for all 31.

tools.name: frankfurter_historical
tools.description: Get ECB forex exchange rates for a specific past date. Daily reference rates, not real-time trading rates. If the date is a weekend or holiday, returns the previous business day's rates. Data available from 1999-01-04 (Euro inception).

symbols.description: Comma-separated target currencies. Omit for all.

tools.name: frankfurter_timeseries
tools.description: Get daily ECB forex rate history for a date range (max 90 days). Daily reference rates, not real-time. Use for currency trend analysis. Only business days included (weekends/holidays omitted). Requires symbols filter to control response size.

end_date.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today, max 90 days from start)

tools.name: frankfurter_convert
tools.description: Convert an amount between two currencies at the latest ECB daily reference rate. Updated once per business day — not suitable for intraday trading rates. Useful for cross-border stock valuation and currency exposure calculations.

tools.name: frankfurter_currencies
tools.description: List all 31 currencies supported by the Frankfurter API with their full names. Use to look up valid currency codes before calling other frankfurter tools.
